hook.line: Stop posting from your plus sign; I repeat, you're killing your views.
hook.visual: Very close handheld selfie, hand waving at camera; bold uppercase captions 'STOP POSTING YOUR' mid-frame and a white 'Creator Search Insights Blueprint' tag on top.

beats.what: Callout opens mid-sentence with the persistent title tag and big word-by-word captions with one word highlighted in red.
'I repeat' doubles down on the warning that you are killing your views.
First cut: promise to show the way that gets content categorized and onto the FYP.
Mid-video ask to watch to the end and save the video to remember the steps.
Phone screen recording appears over her face: typing 'creator search insights' in the search bar.
Red 'THIS' arrow points at the 'Content gap' tab.
A topic page with a search-popularity chart (207K) as she explains people are searching for it now.
Topic page with the AI outline: ready-made titles, hashtags and script.
Red 'THIS' arrow again, on the titles and hashtags to copy.
Ends on her face with the payoff: your content will get to the FYP.

why_it_works: Opens on a 'stop doing X' callout aimed at a habit almost every creator has, so the viewer feels personally caught in the first second.
Speech never stops (1% silence) and the screen changes about every 2.7 s once the phone recording starts, so there is no dead air.
Red 'THIS' arrows tell the eye exactly where to tap, so the steps can be followed on a phone right away.
The save ask comes early and is tied to a benefit (remember the steps), which fits a how-to people will need later.
weaknesses: Face is extremely close and soft in poor light; the phone overlay covers most of it.
The same promise (categorized, FYP) is repeated many times instead of showing a result or number.
Quiet mix (about -35 LUFS) and no music bed.
The first 20 s are talk and promises before any screen is shown.
for_robert: Copy the red 'THIS' arrow on the product screenshot, but make Fred the pointer: he swims to the exact tab and taps it as Robert names it, instead of a static sticker.
